Name: Garbage Day
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
This mod turns all the garbage cans into storages which collect trash throughout the week. This also allows map modders to add more garbage cans on maps other than the Town.
[youtube]HkzI1rORggo[/youtube]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GPXxDLK.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Garbage Cans can be accessed as storages.
[*]More Garbage Cans can be added to maps.
[*]Customize loot items for each Garbage Can.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lG4kcA2.png[/img]
For ease of use, it is recommended to set config options from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fMhu2q8.png[/img]
See [url=https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/StardewMods/tree/develop/GarbageDay#translations]here[/url] for the current status on translations.

Feel free to visit me on my [url=https://lxnq.to/discord]Discord server[/url] for announcements and early access to beta releases of my mods.
You can also request help from me on the Stardew Valley discord in [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/1272025932932055121]#modded-tech-support[/url]﻿ (ping me @LeFauxMatt).
